task.title: Update HP LaserJet Driver Installation for Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Steps to install the HP LaserJet driver on Windows 11, including handling UAC prompts and correcting network timeout settings.

prereq.p: Note: Windows 11 is not supported for this installation task. Please use a supported operating system.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the HP Support website.
step.result: The driver package is saved to your Downloads

step.cmd: Double-click the downloaded driver package to begin installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions in the installation wizard.
When prompted by User Account Control (UAC), click Yes to allow the installation to proceed.
step.result: The installation continues with elevated privileges.

step.cmd: Complete the installation by following the remaining prompts.
step.result: The HP LaserJet driver is installed on your system.

section.title: Network Timeout Configuration
section.p: Ensure the network timeout setting is correctly configured:

step.cmd: Navigate to the Network Settings section.
Set the Network Timeout value to 120 seconds.
step.result: The network timeout is set to the correct default value.
